summary: PRF Technologies (Nasdaq: PRFX), a foreign private issuer filing a US-equivalent Form 6-K, announced on September 9, 2026 it will establish GridFeed, together with DeepSolar operations, as a standalone wholly owned subsidiary to pursue strategic investment, partnerships and commercial collaborations for its AI-driven renewable energy trading platform. No price, stake, premium or timeline terms were disclosed; no advisor or board recommendation named. GridFeed remains wholly owned for now, but the standalone structure creates a vehicle for future transactions. Watch for subsequent stake sales, outside investment or a possible carve-out spin-off, and any disclosure of valuation or strategic partner identity.
